summary: The Associated Press projects at least 259 Democratic House seats. An analysis of Senate races in 13 states complicates Vice President JD Vance and Senator Ted Cruz’s explanation for the midterm losses. The Pentagon pressed Canada publicly over defense spending, Alaska ended a voter-data agreement, the FAA lifted an O’Hare ground stop, states challenged a federal housing rule and a jury convicted Huawei and three subsidiaries. Open items include reported shelving of U.S.–Russia business proposals, reported new tariffs on subsidized production, Huang and Teter House interviews, the Army’s planned Iowa disposal, Iran’s claim of three tanker mine strikes, and the contractor order’s implementation and congressional responses. Coverage of the Fed, Epstein records, Venezuela’s election timetable, new Iran funding text and candidate organizing was limited. The closing scan also found public scrutiny of Trump’s Nvidia holdings, Blanche’s directive on detention litigation, and Kilmar Abrego Garcia’s departure for Spain. The reported breach of an unclassified CIA system and reported continuation of Jensen Huang’s security clearance still need confirmation.
scope: Focused review of the incoming House majority, Republican reactions to the midterms, Pentagon relations with Canada, flight disruptions, housing litigation and China technology enforcement. Other tracked decisions received limited checks or carry earlier findings.

perIssue.AI: The jury verdict and existing hearing plans were checked. Licensing and testimony remain open.
perIssue.EPS: Catch-up checked public committee and floor routes. No production or fresh floor disposition was verified.
perIssue.FED: A targeted search and court index check did not establish a new Cook ruling or hearing change.
perIssue.IMM: Read the new housing complaint. Separate enforcement and other court matters carry earlier dates.
perIssue.IRN: Checked funding reporting and maritime warnings. Operative spending text and the source of the tanker attacks remain open.
perIssue.MID: Checked new House projection, election records, Canada statements, O’Hare and contractor implementation.
perIssue.RUS: Poland confirmed deployment and AP reported the lower-house budget vote. The U.S. business proposal decision remains unverified.
perIssue.SUC: Checked precinct evidence and one local organizer gathering. Neither directly measures the primary field.
perIssue.TAR: Checked official indexes and an announcement lead. Operative rates and dates remain open.
perIssue.VEN: Limited search for Vitol replies and talks. The previous election timetable finding carries.

deviations: Focused review. Some standing outcomes and official or specialist indexes received limited coverage.

outcome_watch.outcome: AP calls Tennessee race for Victoria Broderick, projecting at least 259 Democratic House seats
outcome_watch.finding: The larger projected majority gives incoming House leaders more room to lose some Democratic votes on bills or resolutions. The next House still has to choose its speaker and decide what to bring to a vote.

outcome_watch.outcome: Precinct analysis finds turnout explained more Democratic gains than vote switching in 13 states
outcome_watch.finding: Republicans deciding where to spend money and recruit volunteers have reason to examine who stayed home, alongside why some Trump voters switched. Precinct estimates do not reveal individual moves directly or measure 2028 primary preferences.

outcome_watch.outcome: Pentagon criticizes Canadian defense spending and Canada defends joint air defense
outcome_watch.finding: The public criticism gives U.S. officials a way to press Canada on spending and procurement. Canada’s response invokes an existing joint command. The public exchange does not establish further changes in joint operations or Canada’s aircraft purchase.

outcome_watch.outcome: FAA lifts O’Hare ground stop while radar outage continues to delay flights
outcome_watch.finding: The two stops give lawmakers and the FAA separate problems to track, equipment reliability and staffing. The sources reviewed did not establish the underlying equipment failure or a link to November’s nationwide FAA ground stop.

outcome_watch.outcome: States sue HUD over federal housing aid for families with mixed immigration status
outcome_watch.finding: The plaintiffs are asking a federal court to constrain HUD’s implementation. Filing the suit creates a route to relief for affected households, while the court’s response and any actual loss of aid remain open.

outcome_watch.outcome: U.S. jury convicts Huawei and three subsidiaries in sanctions and trade-secret case
outcome_watch.finding: Prosecutors won a verdict in a case begun under Trump’s first administration. The court will decide penalties. The verdict does not itself change the administration’s chip licensing rules.

outcome_watch.outcome: Alaska ends voter-data agreement and asks the Justice Department to destroy shared records
outcome_watch.finding: Alaska has withdrawn its agreement to share data. Whether the department has relinquished information it already received is a separate question about implementation.

outcome_watch.outcome: Young Republicans in Fort Worth call for changes after the midterms
outcome_watch.finding: The gathering shows observed criticism among the people AP interviewed. It does not establish broader primary reaction or a named candidate commitment.

outcome_watch.outcome: Georgia judge orders Fulton County to share 2020 election records
outcome_watch.finding: The order is for records access. No effect on the latest election result or incoming federal chamber control was established.

outcome_watch.outcome: Federal judge dismisses Texas election certification challenge
outcome_watch.finding: The dismissal removes the obstacle sought by the plaintiffs. It does not change the projected chamber totals.

outcome_watch.outcome: Russian lower house passes wartime budget and tax increases
outcome_watch.finding: The vote shows domestic financing for continued war. The sources do not establish a change in U.S. terms for negotiations.

outcome_watch.outcome: Reported shelving of U.S.–Russia business proposals
outcome_watch.finding: Reuters attributes the account to the Financial Times. A direct search did not recover the original, and republication does not independently establish a decision.

outcome_watch.outcome: Reported new tariffs on subsidized production
outcome_watch.finding: A report preview describes plans. The White House and USTR indexes reviewed did not establish operative rates or dates.

outcome_watch.outcome: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
outcome_watch.finding: Company announcement confirms the board decision.

outcome_watch.outcome: Huang and Teter House interviews
outcome_watch.finding: AP reports planned appearances. No transcript or completed hearing was verified.

outcome_watch.outcome: Army’s planned Iowa disposal
outcome_watch.finding: The Army announced November 25 timing. The reviewed state and Army reports did not establish completion or Sand’s assent.

outcome_watch.outcome: Iran’s claim of three tanker mine strikes
outcome_watch.finding: UK Maritime Trade Operations reports separate attacks with at least one unknown projectile. Its warning does not verify that mines caused the incidents claimed by Iran.

outcome_watch.outcome: Poland says NATO deployed a surveillance aircraft
outcome_watch.finding: Poland’s official announcement advances the earlier authorization report to deployment. It says little about a sustained change in posture or U.S. negotiating terms.

outcome_watch.outcome: Vance and Rubio meet Qatar’s prime minister
outcome_watch.finding: The meetings are part of the prior review. No new authority to make an offer was established.

outcome_watch.outcome: Contractor order’s implementation and congressional responses
outcome_watch.finding: The published order establishes the requirements. The search did not establish a contractor’s reply, privilege assertion or enforcement action.

outcome_watch.outcome: Alaska official election results
outcome_watch.finding: The November 24 ledger recorded the state’s official November 23 posting. The voter-data agreement is a separate matter.

outcome_watch.outcome: Guilfoyle records request
outcome_watch.finding: No public production, reply or compulsory action verified. Check the committee and recipient again.

outcome_watch.outcome: House Hegseth resolution
outcome_watch.finding: Roll call 317 records referral, 211–204. No later House adoption or Senate trial verified.

outcome_watch.outcome: Trump’s Nvidia holdings draw scrutiny after he helped bring back Jensen Huang
outcome_watch.finding: The combination gives congressional investigators and Democrats a specific reason to ask whose interests the intervention served. The disclosures establish a financial interest at a point in time. The reports leave Trump’s current holdings, his motive, Vance’s role and voter reaction unresolved.

outcome_watch.outcome: Blanche orders Justice Department lawyers to help defend immigration detention cases
outcome_watch.finding: The order gives the Justice Department more ways to staff its defense of detention policies. Judges still decide whether detention is lawful. Effects on case delays and other Justice Department work remain open.

outcome_watch.outcome: Kilmar Abrego Garcia leaves the United States for Spain after deportation fight
outcome_watch.finding: The move resolves where he went after the government’s effort to send him to another country. It leaves the broader rules governing deportation and court review to other cases.

outcome_watch.outcome: Reported breach of an unclassified CIA system
outcome_watch.finding: AP attributed the account and reported resolution to an anonymous person. Checked AP’s article. Seek an official account or independent confirmation of scope and resolution.

outcome_watch.outcome: Reported continuation of Jensen Huang’s security clearance
outcome_watch.finding: CBS cites unnamed sources. Seek official confirmation or committee testimony. The available report cannot establish what the clearance permitted or who reviewed it.

outcome_watch.outcome: AP reports earlier DEA decisions left fentanyl unseized
outcome_watch.finding: The investigation raises questions about past operational approvals. The reviewed article did not establish a new leadership or policy decision.

outcome_watch.outcome: Pentagon hires contractors to review military school curricula
outcome_watch.finding: The contracts provide a route for changing curriculum. The article does not establish that schools have adopted the proposed changes.
